questions.question: Which technologies has Alex used on more than one project?

parsed_output.sql: SELECT t.name, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.project_id) AS project_count FROM technologies t JOIN project_technologies pt ON pt.technology_id = t.id GROUP BY t.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pt.project_id) > 1 ORDER BY project_count DESC, t.name
parsed_output.explanation: Lists technologies Alex has used on multiple projects, ordered by how many projects use each one.

body.sql: SELECT t.name, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.project_id) AS project_count FROM technologies t JOIN project_technologies pt ON pt.technology_id = t.id GROUP BY t.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pt.project_id) > 1 ORDER BY project_count DESC, t.name
body.explanation: Lists technologies Alex has used on multiple projects, ordered by how many projects use each one.

questions.question: How old is Simba?

parsed_output.sql: SELECT name, born, CAST(CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - born AS INTEGER) AS age FROM pets WHERE lower(name) LIKE '%simba%'
parsed_output.explanation: Calculates Simba's age from his birth year by subtracting it from the current year.
